test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Avanish got 78% marks in an examination and Kapil got 64% marks in the same examination. If the sum of the marks obtained by Kapil and Avanish is 923, then find the marks obtained by Kapil in the examination.
solution:
• Avanish got 78% marks in an examination and Kapil got 64% marks in the same examination. 

Let the exam be of 'x' marks.

 
• The sum of the marks obtained by Kapil and Avanish is 923.

According to question:

78% of x + 64% of x = 923

⇒ 78/100 × x + 64/100 × x = 923

⇒ (78x + 64x) / 100 = 923

⇒ 142x = 923 × 100

⇒ x = 92300 ÷ 142

⇒ x = 650

The marks obtained by Kapil in the examination = 64% of x 

= 64% of 650

= 64/100 × 650

= 416

Hence, ‘**416**’ is the correct answer.
